purpose: Define predictable Quick Check evidence slots without freezing just-in-time reassessment targets.
selection_principle: The curriculum predicts the evidence slots; the Portfolio determines the just-in-time reassessment targets; the teacher approves the actual questions.

common_rules.new_targets: Resolve from the current section Mastery/I Can learning architecture.
common_rules.reassessment_targets: Select from live Portfolio need at build/use time, not months ahead.
common_rules.teacher_selection_page: Show the exact selected I Can for each slot with four strong sample questions across the row so the teacher can choose, alter, or replace the final item.
common_rules.final_print: Build fresh parallel/scrambled versions from teacher-approved anchors while preserving target and usable difficulty; keep one identical common item across versions.

slots.relationship: second independent question for target A on the same Quick Check; still one assessment opportunity for body-of-evidence independence purposes unless the task itself creates independently judgeable demonstrations

second independent question for target B on the same Quick Check; still one assessment opportunity for body-of-evidence independence purposes unless the task itself creates independently judgeable demonstrations

patterns.reason: No prior Algebra Portfolio evidence exists at course opening.
At a new Unit opening there is little current-unit Portfolio history, so reassessment capacity is better spent on unresolved older-unit evidence.

selection_tiebreakers: Prefer I Cans where another independent convincing opportunity could establish Mastered.
Prefer widespread class need when the Quick Check is common to the whole class.
Use intervention/reteach information to distinguish students who need instruction before reassessment from students ready for another independent opportunity.
Do not waste routine reassessment slots on students/targets already securely mastered when a meaningful transfer opportunity or another unresolved target is more useful.
